description: This file defines the ShoppingCartData class, which models the data related to a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It contains fields for messages, codes, quantities, totals, subtotals, and lists of cart items and order totals, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ShoppingCartData
classes.description: A data transfer object that holds shopping cart information, including items and totals, and extends ShopEntity.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message associated with the shopping cart.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message associated with the shopping cart.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code related to the shopping cart.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code related to the shopping cart.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the total item quantity in the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the total item quantity in the cart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount as a string.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Returns the list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of order totals.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of order totals.
